# globex — harness

**globex** · domain `ecommerce` · lifecycle `provisioned` · tier `standard` · owner team `unset` · 2 sisters

What every sister project inherits, decided once for the family. A sister may opt out of a tool, lower a loop's level or commit to more controls; it may not read another sister, and only the roll-up attaches sister warehouses, read-only.

## Inherited by every sister

| decision | file | effect |
|---|---|---|
| tools | `tools.yaml` | `elementary`, `expectations`, `okf`, `openmetadata`, `recce`, `wren` — each sister may set `enabled: false` |
| loops | `loops.yaml` | the registry as shipped |
| AI controls | `air.yaml` | baseline 0, accepted 0; a sister's baseline is a union with this one |
| delivery | `notify.yaml` | `ask` → `${PF_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_GLOBEX_ASK}`, `default` → `${PF_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_GLOBEX}`, `loops` → `${PF_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_GLOBEX_LOOPS}` |
| budget and data | `group.yaml` | no token ceiling; residency `unset` |
| ontology | `ontology/instance.yaml` | classes `Customer`, `Order`, `Payment`, `Refund`, `Product`, `Location`; validated by `pf check` |
| shared dbt | `shared/transform/` | 1 macro, 0 seeds, 0 tests; identical in every sister |
| shared python | `shared/python/` | none |
| skills | `.claude/skills/` | none — the `globex-group` plugin, enabled in every sister's settings |
| memory | `.memory/notes/` | 0 notes; `pf memory add groups/globex …` |
| evals | `evals/` | 0 cases the whole family must pass |

## The gate, from the group directory

Judged the way the PreToolUse hook judges a session opened here — which is *not* inside a project, and that matters for the last rows.

| path | verdict | by |
|---|---|---|
| `tools.yaml` | allowed | default |
| `loops.yaml` | allowed | default |
| `air.yaml` | impact first | impact_required `**/air.yaml` |
| `notify.yaml` | allowed | default |
| `group.yaml` | allowed | default |
| `ontology/instance.yaml` | allowed | default |
| `ontology/extension.yaml` | allowed | default |
| `shared/transform/macros/example.sql` | allowed | allowlist `**/*.sql` |
| `shared/transform/seeds/example.csv` | allowed | default |
| `.claude/skills/example/SKILL.md` | allowed | allowlist `**/*.md` |
| `kg/group_card.md` | allowed | allowlist `**/*.md` |
| `HARNESS.md` | allowed | denylist_except |
| `loop-ledger.json` | allowed | default |
| `evals/example.json` | allowed | default |
| `.memory/notes/example.md` | allowed | allowlist `**/*.md` |
| `projects/example/CLAUDE.md` | allowed | allowlist `**/*.md` |
| `platform/src/pf/cli.py` | allowed | default |
| `vendor/example/README.md` | allowed | allowlist `**/*.md` |
| `gate.yaml` | allowed | default |

`platform_denylist` — `platform/**`, `vendor/**`, `pyproject.toml`, `uv.lock`, `gate.yaml`, `gate.capabilities.yaml` — applies only when the session resolves to a project.

**These maps travel with the change** (`harness_required`): a run that changes a group-level file must leave every map in the family current, and a run that changes a sister must leave the sister's, its report's and this one current. `pf harness globex` regenerates them all.

## Gaps

- **A group session may write shared infrastructure.** `platform_denylist` applies only when the hook resolves the session to a project; a session opened at `groups/globex` resolves to none, so `platform/src/pf/cli.py`, `vendor/example/README.md` are allowed. Open project work with `pf work`, and platform work at the root.
- **No group skill.** `.claude/skills/` is empty; the group's domain knowledge is in prose and memory only.
- **No AI-control baseline.** `air.yaml` commits to nothing, so `pf air gate` passes by finding nothing to check. `pf air baseline globex <project> --suggest` proposes one.
